about_the_game:
✨Game Introduction​：

Destined one,

Will you seek the truth hidden in the shadows?

Or raise your sword in defiance against all injustice?

Encounter that special "her",

Amid deception and entanglement, the choices you make—

What if you defy the entire world?

Can you still hold fast to your vows...

​​"Deceptive Love Ballad / The Blasphemous Maiden"​​

—A dark fantasy romance GalGame, now begins!

​

You will step into the shoes of the protagonist "Zilin SAI", gradually unraveling the mysteries of "Heart City" Morodo, meeting a diverse cast of characters, encountering your destined "her", and embarking on a unique romantic story.

​✨Game Genre：

  • AVG Visual Novel

  • Word count: Approximately 120,000 words

  • Total playtime: Approximately 3-5 hours

✨Game Features：

  • Multi-branch storyline

  • 15 exquisite character illustrations and CGs

  • Full Chinese voice-over

  • Over ten captivating background music tracks

  • Entirely independently produced by university students

Voice acting by multiple actors and well-timed sound effects for an immersive audio experience!

Additionally, the game includes adorable chibi illustrations to lighten the mood!

We hope everyone enjoys our game and has a unique experience in "Heart City" Morodo!
detailed_description:
Developer's request for players' feedback:​

Most of this game project was developed by me alone. As a novice creator, I am clearly still immature.
I sincerely ask all players to provide valuable opinions about the game—this is extremely important to me.

Thank you for purchasing our game. We wish you all a pleasant life!

short_description: Faced with aggressive detectives, I—"Zilin·SAI"—seemed unable to clear my suspicions. At the critical moment, a mysterious caller contacted me: "I can help you, but the price is to go to the mansion where 'demons' reside." A dark fantasy tale of mind games and romance begins now...
